packet.title: The book's memory example counts allocations differently (book, tests)

body.p: After (the book shows real output). docs/book/src/c.md shows allocations: 195, still live: 0 for its memory example; agents in this session saw 197 (7.28, cli-4) and 196 (perf-17) on different commits, and the same on base commits without their changes, so the count has drifted with later packets and may also depend on the setup (allocator growth, a cache's first use, the environment).

item.p: Mechanism: first find out why the count is what it is and whether it is stable for one build (run the example many times, under the release and the debug-gcc builds, with and without TZ and LANG); if it varies within one build, find the cause and make the example deterministic or show only what is stable (a count that matters to the reader, ); if it only drifted, update the book with tools/check-book-examples.sh --update and check that the text around it is still true.

Done when: tools/check-book-examples.sh matches on c.md in the release build; the cause recorded in the LOG (a D-record only if a decision is made). Done 2026-10-28: the count is stable for one build (194 at HEAD, release and debug-gcc, any TZ, LANG and directory); it drifted with perf-5 (197), perf-12 (196) and perf-16 (194). The book shows 194; its prose no longer repeats the number.
